title: Business Messaging API
content_data:
TikTok Business Messaging API is a suite of interfaces enabling authorized TikTok accounts to exchange direct messages with TikTok users through API-integrated platforms. It allows businesses to seamlessly incorporate real-time messaging into their customer engagement strategies, supporting an organic-to-paid approach and enhancing brand presence on TikTok. > **Note**
> TikTok Business Messaging API is **now in Open Beta in APAC, LATAM, METAP, and North America**. To learn more about regional availability, see [Access to Business Messaging API](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184145137922). Explore the documentation: - Getting started - [Overview](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184079395841): Familiarize yourself with essential terminology. - [Access to Business Messaging API](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184145137922): Ensure that you have completed the necessary data security and privacy reviews and obtained access to Business Messaging API. - [Authorization](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184159540418): Learn the process of obtaining authorization from businesses to manage their TikTok accounts. - [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184175482945): Master the implementation of access tokens and token renewal workflows. - Implementation - [Subscribe to Business Messaging Webhook events via Webhooks API](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832190670631937): Follow the guide to set up real-time Business Messaging notifications. - [Manage direct messages for a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184236919810): Learn how to send, receive, and manage direct messages for a TikTok account. - [Manage the welcome message for a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184264385538): Understand how to create and update welcome messages that greet users when they start a conversation with your TikTok account. - [Manage the suggested questions for a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184277518338): Discover how to set up and manage suggested questions to streamline customer interactions. - [Manage the chat prompts for a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184291198977): Explore how to create and manage chat prompts to guide conversations and enhance user engagement. - [API reference](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184321030145): Explore the comprehensive documentation for all available Business Messaging API endpoints. - Resources - [Return codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184306529874): Reference the common errors for Business Messaging API endpoints.
